rules.description: Cache only anonymous published content on explicitly onboarded hosts
rules.expression: (http.host in {"REPLACE_WITH_VERIFIED_PUBLIC_HOST"} and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/preview") and not any(http.request.headers.names[*] == "authorization") and not any(http.request.headers.names[*] == "cookie"))

rules.description: Never cache private requests, cookies, or APIs
